normalized.result: Yes, for a batch that's sufficient. I selected both archived bookmarks, clicked **Delete permanently**, and it stopped me with a dialog that named the number I was about to delete — "2 bookmarks" — and warned plainly that it can't be undone. Since I'm the one who just ticked those boxes and they're highlighted right there behind the dialog, I can see which ones I've picked, so telling me the count plus the irreversible warning is the right amount of caution before a group delete. And I appreciate that this batch-delete only turns up in the Archive, same careful placement as deleting one — I can't wipe out a group from my everyday library by accident. Cancel would still back me out safely, I assume. This is the safeguard I'd want for deleting several at once.
